SomitiDatabase.title: Somiti Database Bundle
SomitiDatabase.description: Central Somiti operational database including members, transactions, loans, projects, tasks, and cashbook

members.description: List of registered somiti members with profile and authentication info

transactions.description: List of kisti collection and savings deposit transactions

loans.description: List of member loans and repayments

projects.description: List of organization ventures and projects

projectExpenses.description: List of expenses incurred for projects

tasks.description: List of organization tasks and checklist items

cashbook.description: Organization cash in hand ledger entries

updatedBy.description: Name or user ID of person who triggered the save

/somiti_data/{docId}.description: Somiti central documents store holding the central_database document
